zh: 修复数据抓取页「运行批脚本」后自动打开的数据导入页文件变少：站点打开后自己刷新或登录跳转会丢掉下载拦截，现在每个任务前都会重新装上；桌面版还会把运行标签真实下载完成的 CSV 补传给导入页，同名文件只保留一份。
en: Fixed the auto-opened data import page missing files after Run batch on the data capture page: the download capture lost when a site reloads or redirects for login is now re-installed before every task, and the desktop app also forwards CSV files the run tab actually downloaded, keeping one copy per file name.
